questions.question: If (3 + 2√5)² = 29 + K√5, then what is the value of K?
questions.solution:
Method I: (3 + 2√5)²

= (3² + (2√5)² + 2 × 3 × 2√5)

= 9 + 20 + 12√5 = 29 + 12√5

On comparing, 29 + 12√5 = 29 + K√5

we get,

K = 12

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__ **

29 + 12√5 = 29 + K√5

⇒ K√5 = 29 - 29 + 12√5

⇒ K√5 = 12√5

∴ K = 12

questions.question: 24 women can complete a work in 45 days. Then in how many days the work would be completed by 18 women?
questions.solution:
Let D days be required to complete the work.

M₁ × D₁ = M₂ × D₂

24 × 45 = 18 × D

D = (24 × 45)/18 = 60

∴ Work is completed in 60 days.

questions.question: 50 litres of mixture of alcohol and water is in the ratio of 1 : 4 respectively. If 10 litres of mixture is taken off and replaced with 10 litres of water. Then what is the new ratio of alcohol and water respectively?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

50 litres of mixture of alcohol and water is in the ratio of 1 : 4 respectively.

10 litres of mixture is taken off and replaced with 10 litres of water. 

**Calculation:**

Ratio of alcohol and water = 1 : 4

Let, ratio = k

k + 4k = 50

⇒ k = 10

Quantity of alcohol and water = 10 L and 40 L

10 L of mixture is taken off, that also contain alcohol and water in the ratio 1 : 4

⇒ 2 L alcohol and 8 L water is taken off

On adding 10 L water to the mixture,

Quantity of alcohol = 10 - 2 = 8 L

Quantity of water = 40 - 8 + 10 = 42 L

Ratio = 8 : 42 = 4 : 21

questions.question: Average weight of a class of boys is 24 kg. When a boy having weight 36 kg leaves the class and a new boy having weight 30 kg joins the class, then the average weight become 23.5 kg. How many boys are there in the class?
questions.solution:
Let the number of boys in the class be n.

Total sum of the weight = 24n

According to question,

frac{{24n - 36 + 30}}{n} = 23.5

24n – 6 = 23.5n

0.5n = 6

n = 12

∴ Number of boys in the class are 12.

questions.question: A 120 litres mixture of milk and water contains 40% milk. How much milk (in litres) must be added so that milk becomes 50%?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Quantity of Mixture = 120 litres

Percentage of milk in mixture = 40%

**CALCULATION:**

Quantity of milk in the mixture = 40% of 120 = 48 L

⇒ Qunatity of water in the mixture = 120 – 48 = 72 L

In the final mixture, quantity of milk is 50%

⇒ Quantity of milk = Quantity of water = 72 L

∴ Quantity of milk added = 72 – 48 = 24 L

questions.question: Side of the square base of a pyramid is 8 cm. The pyramid is cut in two parts by a plane parallel to its base such that heights of upper and lower parts are in ratio 1 : 3 respectively. What is the ratio of volume of lower and upper parts respectively?
questions.solution:
Let h be the height of the pyramid, measured from the center of the base to the apex of the pyramid

volume of a square based pyramid = a²(h/3) = 8²(h/3) = 64h/3

where a is the length of a side of the base

Let s be the slant height of the pyramid, then

s = sqrt {{h²} + {{( {a/2} )}²}} = sqrt {{h²} + {{( {8/2} )}²}} = sqrt {{h²} + {{( 4 )}²}} = sqrt {{h²} + 16} 

Now the pyramid is cut in two parts by a plane parallel to its base such that height of upper and lower parts are in ratio 1 : 3

Slant height will also be divided in the ratio 1 : 3

So, let the slant height of the upper pyramid be s₁, height will be h/4 and base be a₁

s₁ = frac{{sqrt {{h²} + 16} }}{4}

So, base of the upper pyramid will be,

{( {frac{{sqrt {{h²} + 16} }}{4}} )²} = (h/4)² + (a₁/2)²

On solving,

a₁ = 2

Then, Volume of upper pyramid = frac{{4{{ x }}( {{{h}}/4} )}}{3} = h/3

Volume of frustum = volume of actual pyramid - volume of upper pyramid formed by cutting the actual pyramid

volume of frustum = 64h/3 - h/3 = 63h/3

So, the required ratio will be = 63 : 1

questions.question: ΔPQR is a right angled at Q. If PQ = 8 cm and PR = (QR + 2) cm. What is the value (in cm) of PR?
questions.solution:
Let QR = x

PR = x + 2

Applying Pythagoras theorem,

PR² = PQ² + QR²

(x + 2)² = 64 + x²

x² + 4 + 4x = 64 + x²

4x = 60

x = 15

PR = x + 2 = 17 cm
